neighbours.label: 'earlier' / 'previous' / 'prior' when it points back to existing scholarship, right before 'work' or 'research' (builds on earlier | work); the same words about time or order stay quiet
fire: The new model draws on earlier work by Hinton and colleagues.
Our analysis extends previous work on bird migration.

The survey relies heavily on earlier work in social psychology.
This article expands on previous research about sleep and memory.
Her method borrows from earlier work on protein folding.
The team's approach follows from previous work on graph algorithms.
The proposal is grounded in prior work on language acquisition.
quiet: The new model arrived earlier than Hinton and colleagues expected.
Our flight left from the previous gate after a short delay.
The reef was visited prior to the storm season.
The surveyor woke earlier than usual on Monday.
This article appeared in the previous issue of the magazine.
Her method was patented earlier this year.
The team's captain played for the previous owner of the club.
The proposal was submitted prior to the deadline.
